verdict.rationale: Insomnia supports OpenAPI as an import/export format and lets users design, lint, and export OpenAPI specs (insomnia-docs-5, insomnia-docs-8, insomnia-docs-19, insomnia-docs-49), which enables downloading a machine-readable spec. However, this is framed around import/export/design workflows rather than a dedicated 'download spec' feature, and there's no independent confirmation of the export UX or format fidelity. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an export/download action for OpenAPI specs, independent/hands-on verification of spec export quality, and confirmation this works outside the Design feature context.
